info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Customer Pay Statement Submission API
info.description: The Customer Pay Statement Submission API enables businesses to facilitate the submission of pay statements on behalf of customers. This endpoint allows authorized users to create and submit pay statement documents for individual customers identified by their unique customer ID. Typical consumers include financial institutions, payroll service providers, and HR departments looking to streamline pay statement processing. By leveraging this API, organizations can enhance their payroll and financial reporting systems significantly.

post.summary: Generate a pay statement for a specific customer.
post.description: This endpoint allows you to generate a detailed pay statement for the specified customer. It retrieves the necessary financial data related to the customer's transactions and presents it in a structured format, suitable for review or record-keeping.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to submit a pay statement for the customer identified by CUST-100045. It requires specific details in JSON format to process the customer's payment statement accurately.
